title: Charge one direct connector call on the one-by-one instance
body:
## Summary
- The published connector alphabet allows only `B` and `A`. On one source and one output, `B A B A` meets all eight dirty states, and no shorter word in that alphabet does.
- One direct product call meets the same eight states. Its price is one complete call, against four calls for the old word.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. The 945-pairing census is not rerun.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/connector-direct-call/verify.py`
